name: Build Site
description: Build a Zola static site from a folder in this workspace's sandbox (/project/... or /shared/<this workspace>/...) and put it live on the pages site, at /<slug>/. The folder needs a zola.toml. Its theme is the site's own themes/<name>/, or one taken at build time when zola.toml says where from: theme = "agent-site" with [extra.build] theme_from = "system" for the repo's themes in /system/themes, or theme_from = "<workspace>" for /shared/<workspace>/themes/<name>. The build has no network, and the link it gives is the site's address (base_url is set for you). The output goes into /public/<slug>, replacing what was there, and is published like any page in /public; zola's errors come back if it doesn't build.
author: anything

path.description: The site's folder in the sandbox, with its zola.toml, e.g. '/project/sites/portfolio'.

slug.description: The site's name in its URL (lowercase letters, digits and hyphens); the folder's name if left out.
